rows.name: aspect-ratio
rows.recommendation: 실제 이미지의 object-cover 조합과 1:1 비율 비교.

examples.title: Square and widescreen media
examples.description: The ratio controls the frame; object-fit controls how the image fills it.

rows.name: button-group
rows.recommendation: orientation=vertical, 아이콘/분할 action 조합.

examples.title: Vertical and icon actions
examples.description: Use a group label and individual accessible names. Grouping does not turn buttons into a menu or tab list.

rows.name: accordion
rows.recommendation: multiple 배열 값과 controlled value 조합.

examples.title: Multiple open sections
examples.description: Control the array of open sections when the application needs to observe or reset expansion.

rows.name: toggle-group
rows.recommendation: vertical orientation과 앱에 전달되는 배열 값 표시.

examples.title: Vertical controlled selection
examples.description: Multiple selection uses an array of values. The result belongs to the application.

rows.name: toggle
rows.recommendation: sm 크기 비교와 controlled pressed 결과.

examples.title: Compact controlled toggle
examples.description: A toggle expresses an on/off preference for an action; it does not submit a checkbox value.

rows.name: native-select
rows.recommendation: NativeSelectOptGroup으로 그룹, small 및 invalid Field 조합.

examples.title: Grouped native options
examples.description: Native optgroups, a compact control, and an invalid field retain browser selection and form submission.

rows.name: input-group
rows.recommendation: Textarea part, suffix 단위, invalid 상태, 검색 action 결과. disabled 입력과 별도 버튼을 함께 잠그는 사용법.

examples.title: Search, units and multiline
examples.description: Addons and buttons belong to the same control. The application owns search results and disables both input and action.

rows.name: field
rows.recommendation: FieldSet/Legend와 RadioGroup/Checkbox 조합; Textarea/NativeSelect의 FieldControl render 연결.

examples.title: Related fields and form values
examples.description: Use a legend for the group, labels for each control, and a local submission result. No form engine is required.

rows.name: radio-group
rows.recommendation: controlled 값과 form 제출 결과, invalid Field 조합.

examples.title: Form selection and invalid state
examples.description: Radio values share one form name. An invalid group describes how to correct the selection.

rows.name: checkbox
rows.recommendation: 상위 전체 선택과 자식 항목을 연결하는 실제 indeterminate 예제 및 form 제출 결과.

examples.title: Derived mixed selection
examples.description: The parent is indeterminate when only some children are selected. Form submission contains the checked child values.

rows.name: rotating-content
rows.recommendation: controls=false의 외부 controlled pause button 조합; decorative heading 밖에 접근 가능한 제어를 둔다.

examples.title: An external pause control
examples.description: When controls are hidden, supply controlled paused state and an accessible control outside the decorative text.

rows.name: text-reveal
rows.recommendation: duration/stagger를 비교할 수 있는 replay 예제.

examples.title: Duration, stagger and replay
examples.description: Short and slower timings use the same readable text. Replay remounts the example rather than adding a component replay API.

rows.name: button
rows.recommendation: xs/sm/default/lg/icon/icon-sm 크기 비교, 아이콘 label, asChild 실제 링크.

examples.title: Sizes, icon names and links
examples.description: Choose control size consistently. Icon buttons still need labels; navigation keeps an anchor element.

rows.name: input
rows.recommendation: password/number 등 대표 HTML 타입, error text와 aria-invalid/aria-describedby 연결. file 선택 후는 기존 예제에서 도달 가능.

examples.title: Input types and validation feedback
examples.description: Native types preserve browser behavior. Associate error text with the invalid input.

rows.name: select
rows.recommendation: 라벨 있는 그룹·여러 그룹과 separator, 많은 옵션의 스크롤, sm/disabled/invalid, alignItemWithTrigger 비교.

examples.title: Groups
examples.description: Organize choices with group labels and separators. The field label names the input.

examples.title: Sizes, errors and positioning
examples.description: Compare compact and standard controls. Invalid fields explain the error, and disabled fields remain unavailable.

examples.title: Long option lists
examples.description: The popup scrolls within its available height and keeps keyboard selection on the active option.

rows.name: switch
rows.recommendation: sm/default 비교, disabled/invalid, controlled 즉시 설정 결과.

examples.title: Sizes and unavailable settings
examples.description: Controlled state can update a visible result. Disabled switches are excluded from interaction; invalid switches explain the constraint.

rows.name: tabs
rows.recommendation: default/line/segmented 비교, vertical, disabled tab, 앱 controlled value.

examples.title: Variants and controlled selection
examples.description: Default, line and segmented lists use the same selection model. Vertical lists use vertical keyboard navigation.

rows.name: label
rows.recommendation: Checkbox/Switch 연결과 disabled control에 맞춘 label 조합.

examples.title: Labels for binary controls
examples.description: A label names its control and enlarges the target. A disabled control remains disabled when its label is clicked.

rows.name: textarea
rows.recommendation: disabled/readOnly/invalid 및 description/error 연결; controlled 글자 수는 앱 조합으로 설명.

examples.title: Character feedback, read-only and disabled
examples.description: Character limits and validation are application rules. Keep help and error text connected to the field.

rows.name: card
rows.recommendation: sm/default density 비교, 이미지와 정보·action의 조합.

examples.title: Compact cards and media
examples.description: Card sizes change content density. A leading image can share the card boundary while actions keep normal control semantics.

rows.name: separator
rows.recommendation: 높이가 확보된 vertical separator 조합, decorative=false의 의미 설명.

examples.title: Vertical and semantic separation
examples.description: Vertical separators need a container height. Decorative rules do not announce a separator to assistive technology.

rows.name: dialog
rows.recommendation: controlled open, 긴 내용의 스크롤, showCloseButton=false일 때 명시적 닫기 제어.

examples.title: Controlled dialog with scrollable content
examples.description: Explicit close actions stay available when the corner close button is hidden. Escape and focus return remain primitive behavior.

rows.name: dropdown-menu
rows.recommendation: Group/Label/Shortcut, CheckboxItem, RadioGroup/RadioItem, Submenu와 실제 선택 결과.

examples.title: Checkbox, radio and nested actions
examples.description: Persist menu choices in application state. Shortcut hints describe commands; they do not register keyboard shortcuts.

rows.name: popover
rows.recommendation: side/align 배치 비교와 controlled open 조합.

examples.title: Positioning and controlled state
examples.description: Positioners may flip to fit the viewport. Controlled state still preserves trigger, Escape and focus behavior.

rows.name: sheet
rows.recommendation: left/top/bottom 방향 비교, 긴 내용과 명시적 닫기.

examples.title: Sides and long content
examples.description: Choose a side for the task. The content region scrolls while header and explicit close action stay accessible.

rows.name: tooltip
rows.recommendation: 4방향 배치와 아이콘 버튼의 visible/accessible label 조합.

examples.title: Placement and accessible icon targets
examples.description: Tooltips supplement labels. Icon buttons must remain named even when the tooltip is closed.

rows.name: chart
rows.recommendation: 다중 시리즈+Legend, line/area 등 대표 Recharts 조합, tooltip dot/line/dashed 및 formatter. 각 차트가 별도 Leement API인 것은 아니다.

examples.title: Multiple series and legend
examples.description: Compare two series with a line chart, semantic colors, a legend and formatted tooltip values. The text summary remains available without hovering.

rows.name: brand-gradient-text
rows.recommendation: animated=false와 paused 비교 및 실제 정지 제어.

examples.title: Static and paused gradients
examples.description: A static gradient keeps the brand treatment without animation. A paused gradient can resume through an external button.

rows.name: status-notice
rows.recommendation: action 슬롯으로 재시도·도움말이 있는 결과 메시지; 기존 tone 예제는 유지.

examples.title: Recovery and contextual actions
examples.description: Pair a notice with a useful next step. Application callbacks own retry and completion state.

rows.name: reveal-content
rows.recommendation: 6 variants의 차이, line/stagger의 data-reveal-item/media/line 표시와 replay. variant만 바꾼 빈 wrapper를 늘리지 않는다.

examples.title: Reveal variants and child markers
examples.description: Line and stagger variants animate marked children. Replay resets the demo; reduced motion shows content immediately.

rows.name: collapsible
rows.recommendation: disabled/controlled 예제와 form controls를 포함한 긴 panel 조합.

examples.title: Controlled expansion and disabled trigger
examples.description: Control expansion when another action must open the details. Put padding inside the animated content rather than on the height container.

rows.name: progress
rows.recommendation: indeterminate(value=null)의 실제 표현을 확인한 후 추가, 0/100 경계와 진행값 변경. 자동 Track과 수동 parts 중복 금지 안내.

examples.title: Determinate and indeterminate
examples.description: Known progress shows its percentage, including zero and completion. Unknown progress omits an invented percentage.

rows.name: toast
rows.recommendation: info/warning/error/loading, promise 결과, action/dismiss 및 host theme 연결. Toaster는 한 번만 mount.

examples.title: Types, promise and action
examples.description: One Toaster is mounted in the representative preview above. These triggers share it; promise work and undo callbacks are owned by the application.

rows.name: avatar
rows.recommendation: 실제 이미지, 깨진 이미지 fallback, 크기 비교.

examples.title: Images, fallback and sizes
examples.description: Loaded images use informative alternative text. Failed images fall back to initials; size is controlled with className.

rows.name: avatar-stack
rows.recommendation: animate=true 비교와 실제 이미지, 서로 다른 size. 자동 overflow count가 있다고 가정하지 않는다.

examples.title: Images, sizes and expansion
examples.description: Animate the stack on hover without adding automatic overflow rules. The application chooses which people to include.

rows.name: calendar
rows.recommendation: disabled date predicate, range 내부 제외 날짜, ko-KR/startDay=1; 기존3 modes를 새로 없는 것처럼 추가하지 않는다.

examples.title: Locale, unavailable dates and range limits
examples.description: Start weeks on Monday and prevent ranges that cross an unavailable day. The application owns availability data.

rows.name: list
rows.recommendation: renderItem으로 맞춤 row를 만드는 source 예제.

examples.title: Custom row content
examples.description: Custom rendering changes row content while built-in drag and move controls keep ownership of reordering.

rows.name: table
rows.recommendation: TableHeader/Body/Footer/Caption 조합; legacy empty; AdvancedDataTable로 연결. 기본 Table과 DataTable 이름/API 차이를 설명.

examples.title: Native composition and empty results
examples.description: Table parts preserve HTML semantics. Use the Data Table pattern when sorting, filtering and selection must work together.

rows.name: code-block
rows.recommendation: 단일 code prop, showLineNumbers=false, 지원하지 않는 language의 plain text 처리.

examples.title: Single code and plain-text fallback
examples.description: A single source does not need a language selector. Unknown languages render safely as plain text, with line numbers omitted.

rows.name: contribution-graph
rows.recommendation: onSelect 결과, 짧은 기간과 ko-KR 예제.

examples.title: Localized interval and selection
examples.description: Use a short reporting interval and read the selected day through the application callback.

rows.name: choicebox
rows.recommendation: controlled 선택 및 form/name 제출 결과, fieldset 전체 disabled.

examples.title: Controlled choice and form submission
examples.description: The controlled selection remains a native radio value. Disabling the fieldset locks all choices.

rows.name: combobox
rows.recommendation: control 전체 disabled, default selection, controlled value를 앱에 반영하는 예제. 그룹/다중/async는 현 API 미지원.

examples.title: Controlled assignment and disabled field
examples.description: Observe the selected option in application state. Disabling the whole combobox differs from disabling individual options.

rows.name: dropzone
rows.recommendation: 단일/전체 disabled 비교; onFiles로 파일 목록·정보를 외부에 전달하는 실제 소비자 예제와 거절 시나리오 안내.

examples.title: Single, multiple and disabled
examples.description: Read selected files locally to show names and sizes. Selecting a file does not upload it to a server.

rows.name: tags
rows.recommendation: disabled와 controlled value의 실제 소비자 저장 값 예제. limit 기능을 미구현으로 분류하지 않는다.

examples.title: Controlled tags and locked values
examples.description: Read tag changes outside the control. Disabled tags cannot be added or removed.

rows.name: image-crop
rows.recommendation: aspect=1 및 16/9 fixed aspect 비교. 실제 파일 저장은 앱 책임.

examples.title: Fixed crop ratios
examples.description: Choose a square or widescreen crop. The callback returns percentages; creating or uploading the resulting image is application work.

rows.name: ticker
rows.recommendation: negative 값과 layout=card를 비교; 다른 currency/locale은 선택적 보완.

examples.title: Negative change and localized currency
examples.description: A card layout supports more context. Currency formatting and sign convey the value without relying on color alone.

rows.name: stories
rows.recommendation: presentation=viewer와 autoAdvanceMs; pause 및 reduced motion 규칙. Reel과 같은 항목으로 합치지 않는다.

examples.title: Embedded viewer and automatic advance
examples.description: Use an embedded viewer when thumbnails are unnecessary. Playback controls pause automatic advance; reduced motion avoids autoplay.

rows.name: announcement
rows.recommendation: href 없는 static 및 dismissible=false 비교.

examples.title: Static and persistent announcement
examples.description: Informational announcements can omit a link and dismissal. Use a link only when there is a destination.

rows.name: banner
rows.recommendation: tone=subtle 비교와 tone에 맞는 action 대비.

examples.title: Subtle contextual banner
examples.description: Use a quiet surface for secondary guidance and an outlined action for a clear, readable next step.

rows.name: typography
rows.recommendation: 누락된 small role, 동일 heading element에 다른 visual variant 비교.

examples.title: Visual hierarchy and HTML meaning
examples.description: The same heading element can use different visual variants. Small text remains legible supporting content.

rows.name: color-picker
rows.recommendation: controlled value/onValueChange로 외부 실제 대상 색상을 바꾸는 예제, translucent initial value와 disabled.

examples.title: Controlled color and transparency
examples.description: Change a local illustration fill to observe the selected color, including alpha. These example values belong to content, not the system palette.

rows.name: editor
rows.recommendation: readOnly 전환과 onChange HTML을 앱 결과에 전달하는 예제. controlled value prop은 없는 API이므로 약속하지 않는다.

examples.title: Read-only mode and change output
examples.description: Toggle editing and inspect the application’s HTML result. Rendering stored HTML elsewhere requires your own sanitization policy.

rows.name: glimpse
rows.recommendation: image 없는 text-only preview와 비교.

examples.title: Text-only preview
examples.description: A link preview can contain just a title and description. Navigation remains available without opening the hover card.

rows.name: pill
rows.recommendation: disabled removal과 trailing slot.

examples.title: Trailing content and locked removal
examples.description: A trailing slot can show supplemental metadata. Disabled removal keeps a required value present.

rows.name: spinner
rows.recommendation: sm/md/lg 크기 비교. 이미 있는8 variants는 새로 추가하지 않는다.

examples.title: Spinner sizes
examples.description: Match the spinner to its context. Each instance keeps an accessible loading label.
